momentslater.heading: What Moments Later helps you do

units.text: Moments Later helps you capture life as it happens, then come back to it later through journaling, timeline, richer day context, Memory Gallery milestones, and a calmer way to hold on to the moments that matter.
Capture moments fast
Write a quick line, save a photo, or log a moment from Apple Watch before it disappears.
Build a real journal
Short captured moments can grow into a fuller journal entry when you finally have time to sit with the day.
See richer context
Bring in details like weather, health, music, people, and place so memories feel grounded in what the day was really like.
Revisit meaningful days
Browse your timeline and go back to the moments worth remembering instead of letting them disappear into the blur.
Unlock milestones
Unlock achievements and see your captured life take shape with free and premium milestones in the gallery.

momentslater.heading: Capture now. Reflect later. Grow the memory over time.

units.text: You do not need to write a perfect journal entry in the moment. You only need enough to save it now so it is still there when you have a quiet minute tonight.
1. Capture a moment instantly
Write a quick note, save a photo, or speak from Apple Watch before the moment slips away.
2. Turn small moments into a real journal
When the day slows down, your saved moments give you something real to build from instead of a blank page.
3. Add the details around the day
Context like weather, people, music, health, and place helps you remember not just what happened, but what the day felt like.
4. Revisit the days that mattered
The timeline makes it easy to move back through the moments you want to keep instead of losing them in the pace of life.
5. Let the app carry more of the memory
Integrated context means activities, workouts, weather, and other day signals can help the memory feel fuller without extra work from you.
6. Watch your gallery grow
As you keep capturing, the Memory Gallery unlocks milestones so the app reflects progress, streaks, and the shape of your lived life.

momentslater.heading: Capture a moment before you even reach for your phone.

units.text: Tap the complication on your wrist. Speak. Done. Moments Later transcribes your voice and saves the moment instantly — no phone, no typing, no unlocking anything.
Tap the complication
One tap on your Watch face opens Moments Later instantly.
Speak the moment
Say what happened. A few words is enough.
It is saved
Speech to text captures it and stores it. The moment is yours.

momentslater.heading: One Premium purchase across your supported devices.

units.text: Premium adds richer journal context and more Memory Gallery milestones. Your purchase is shared across supported devices through your App Store account, including Mac.
What Premium adds
Richer day context that helps a memory feel tied to a real day, not just a short note.
Context details like weather, people, place, music, and health signals around the moment.
Activity and workout context, including Strava-connected moments and movement through the day.
A fuller journaling experience built from the moments you already captured.
More Memory Gallery milestones and unlocks beyond the free set.
A broader version of the app as Moments Later keeps expanding.
Shared Premium access across supported devices, including Mac.
Richer context around the day
Premium helps the app carry more of the memory for you, with context like weather, location, health, music, people, and activity details that make the day easier to revisit later.
Memory Gallery
Premium also expands the Memory Gallery with more milestones, unlocks, and a stronger sense of progress as your captured life builds up over time.

Moments Later started with a wish — that there had been a way to capture more of what happened when my kids were small. The little things they said. The ordinary afternoons. Now they are grown and on their own, and some of those moments are just gone.
This app is the one that would have helped then. It is here now for anyone still in those years — or anyone who simply wants to hold on to what is happening today.
— Roger, Founder
Busy parents who want to save what their kids said before the day moves on.
People moving between meetings, commutes, errands, and real life.
Apple Watch users who need a fast way to log a moment immediately.
Anyone who wants memory capture without the pressure of instant journaling.
Small routines, places, meals, walks, and conversations worth keeping.
End-of-day reflection with something real to build from.

MapleTrail Software Inc. is the brand behind Moments Later — focused on creating software that feels useful, human, calm, and enduring. The goal is not to turn memory into a productivity system. It is to help people keep more of everyday life.
Fast capture for moments, memories, and reflections in real life.
Reflection that builds naturally from what you already captured.
Context that helps memories feel grounded in a real day.
Design that stays calm, clear, and emotionally warm.
Tools that work for everyone, not just disciplined journalers.
Questions, feedback, partnerships, or interest in Moments Later can be sent directly by email. MapleTrail will reply with more information when available.

momentsaway.heading: Plan the next place. Keep the whole story.

units.text: Moments Away organizes your travel record around places. Save countries, provinces or states, cities, and landmarks; log visits; add notes, people, photos, and videos; then see the bigger picture.
Map and remember
Save places from the map, record return visits, and add the notes, people, photos, and videos that give them meaning.
Plan what is next
Use the Travel Checklist to keep track of countries and territories you have visited—and the ones you want to visit.
See the journey take shape
Review your collection with Year in Travel, Trip Stories, stats, and Home Screen widgets built from your own record.

momentsaway.heading: Your places and notes are your travel record.

units.text: Keep your saved places, visits, notes, and media in a record you control. Use optional iCloud sync across your Apple devices, plus backups and exports for your own copies.
Location

Photos and videos

Sync, backup, and export

ifneeded.heading: A calm place for information that is usually scattered.

units.text: If Needed is built for practical readiness, not paperwork overload. Start with a simple plan, fill in what matters, and keep the important details findable.
Collect the essentials
Bills, money, insurance, digital life, household details, wishes, and trusted contacts.
Review what needs attention
See missing locations, access notes, stale bills, and items that need a quick check.
Share when ready
Create readable handoff PDFs and trusted-person packets when you decide it is time.
If Needed can work without a MapleTrail account. Private iCloud sync is optional and uses your own Apple iCloud account when you turn it on.
No ads
No third-party advertising tracking.
Device authentication
Use Face ID, Touch ID, or device passcode.
Private export
You choose when to create or share a handoff PDF.

ifneeded.heading: Free to start. Unlock once when your plan grows.

units.text: The free version includes the starter plan and up to 8 total plan items. The one-time Lifetime Unlock adds unlimited items, PDF export, trusted-person packets, and private iCloud sync.
Unlimited plan items.
Handoff PDF export.
Trusted-person sharing packets.
Private iCloud sync.
One-time purchase, not a subscription.
If Needed helps organize information. It is not legal, financial, medical, insurance, tax, or estate-planning advice.

acadie.heading: A guided way into Acadian memory.

units.text: Acadie brings together cinematic stories, guided exploration, family names, kitchen traditions, voices, gatherings, and personal progress in one connected guide.
Watch and read cinematic stories

Explore living Acadie

Build your own trail

Acadie connects people, decisions, places, and movement across generations. Move from a single scene to the larger story around it, with cultural context kept close at hand.
Cinematic series
Watch and read Acadian stories with narration, subtitles, saved progress, and further context.
Guided exploration
Follow trails through communities, events, food traditions, heritage sites, regions, and towns.
Roots and memory
